response.review.critic: Rolling Stone 1917 movie review. Quote: "In the first shot of this groundbreaking World War I film, two young British soldiers — lance corporals Schofield (George MacKay) and Blake (Dean-Charles Chapman) — are caught napping in a field. It’s the last time they, or we in the audience, will be able to catch a breath. For the next two hours, director Sam Mendes and cinematographer Roger Deakins will stalk these young men in what seems like one continuous take, tagging along as they charge through enemy territory on a mission to save lives. Their orders from General Erinmore (Colin Firth) are crystal clear: They must make their way across booby-trapped, corpse-strewn terrain in France to hand-deliver a message to Col. Mackenzie (Benedict Cumberbatch), commander of the Second Battalion. It contains orders to call off a planned advance against the German army, falsely assumed to be on the ropes. Turns out it’s a trap that could result in the slaughter of more than 1,600 British soldiers, including Blake’s brother (Richard Madden). With communications down, the only hope rests with two boys who can barely shave."

utterances.speaker: assistant

utterances.text: No way, there isn't two tickets to Doolittle at 5:00 PM?

utterances.speaker: assistant

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: Hi, I would like to order tickets for a movie tonight.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Which show do you want to see?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: I would like to see Spies in Disguise.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: That is a great choice. What city are you going to?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: I'm going to Austin, TX.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: How about the AFS Cinema in Austin?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: That would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: How many are in your party?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: I have 4 people, 2 kids and 2 adults.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: They have Spies in Disguise at 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM tonight.

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: Oh that won't work. Can you please check for Little Women?

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Yes, I see they have tickets available for the 8:00PM and 9:00 PM show tonight.

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: Oh, I needed 6:00 PM or 7:00 PM. That won't work later because the kids get tired.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Would you like me to check for tomorrow evening?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: No thanks. I think I will just have to pass on a movie tonight.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Oh, I'm sorry that I couldn't help you

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: That's okay.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Can I help you find a different movie instead at the earlier time?

utterances.speaker: user
utterances.text: No thanks. That won't be necessary.

utterances.speaker: assistant
utterances.text: Have a good evening!
